cover: Man in custody shot dead by police
Celebratory gunfire kills up to two

stories.label: India · Life & safety
stories.head: A death in police custody
bullets: Ratan Sheikh was arrested over a constable's shooting.
He was killed in police firing on 15 Nov.
Police say he fired at them; no probe reported.

stories.label: Sudan's war
stories.head: Gunfire over a false report
bullets: Shots celebrated a false report that the army took Al-Nuhud.
25 to 45+ people were injured, reports say.
Accounts differ on who fired; no official statement.

stories.label: World · Assembly
stories.head: Arrests as ASEAN summit opens
bullets: Range is the police and organiser counts.
12 were hurt in Manila; 22 media workers harassed, union says.
Police say the rallies had no permit.

stories.label: Palestine
stories.head: An AFP contributor detained
bullets: Troops took Mohammad Ateeq in a 1:30am raid, his wife says.
The military says he is suspected of Hamas ties.
AFP asks for evidence or his release.
